coverage: Tang Chang'an–Luoyang regional detail. Intervals describe layer coverage, not a site's entire lifetime. Named periods can omit closures. Coordinates are approximate site markers; no reconstructed footprints are implied.
coordinateSource: Wikidata P625, CC0, retrieved 2026-11-02. Descriptions are original summaries of linked historical sources.

sites.title: 太极宫
sites.detail: 隋代宫城，唐初继续使用。此点表示宫城遗址的大致位置。
sites.detailEn: A Sui palace complex used by the early Tang court. The marker identifies the approximate archaeological area.

sites.title: 大明宫
sites.detail: 始建于634年，后成为唐代重要宫廷与政务中心，896年毁于战火。
sites.detailEn: Construction began in 634. The palace became a Tang court and government center and was destroyed in 896.

sites.title: 大雁塔
sites.detail: 652年由玄奘主持兴建，用于保存从印度带回的经卷。现存建筑经历后世修缮。
sites.detailEn: Built in 652 under Xuanzang to house scriptures brought from India. The surviving structure includes later alterations.

sites.title: 小雁塔
sites.detail: 荐福寺塔，始建于707年，是唐代长安佛教建筑的重要遗存。
sites.detailEn: The Jianfu Temple pagoda was begun in 707 and survives as a major monument of Tang Chang'an.

sites.title: 白马寺
sites.detail: 始建于东汉68年的佛寺。此图层标示其唐代时期的位置，非现存建筑的年代。
sites.detailEn: Founded in 68 during the Eastern Han. This layer marks the Tang-era site, rather than dating today's buildings to the Tang.

sites.title: 龙门石窟
sites.detail: 伊河两岸的石窟群，北魏至唐代持续营造，唐代造像是其中的重要部分。
sites.detailEn: Caves along the Yi River were carved from the Northern Wei through the Tang, including major Tang Buddhist sculptures.

sites.title: 兴庆宫遗址
sites.detail: 714年由唐玄宗藩邸改为离宫，后扩建朝堂并成为听政之所。点位取今遗址公园区域，不表示唐代宫墙范围。
sites.detailEn: Xuanzong’s former residence became a palace in 714 and later a government center. The marker lies within today’s heritage park; it does not trace Tang palace walls.

sites.title: 华清宫遗址
sites.detail: 644年在骊山营建汤泉宫，671年改称温泉宫，747年扩建并改称华清宫。756年遭兵火，本图层仅显示此前的宫苑时期。
sites.detailEn: The Lishan retreat was established as Tangquan Palace in 644, renamed Wenquan Palace in 671 and Huaqing Palace in 747. This layer ends before its destruction in 756.

sites.title: 青龙寺遗址
sites.detail: 隋代始建，621年寺废，662年复立为观音寺，711年改称青龙寺。804—806年空海在此学习。845年寺废，846年称护国寺，855年恢复青龙寺名；图上名称随年份变化。
sites.detailEn: Founded under the Sui, the temple closed in 621 and reopened in 662. Kūkai studied here in 804–806. Labels follow its documented names and omit the closure periods.

sites.title: 兴教寺
sites.detail: 669年为安奉玄奘遗骨而建，寺内有玄奘及弟子相关塔院。此点表示寺址，不代表现存殿宇均建于唐代。
sites.detailEn: Established in 669 to house Xuanzang’s remains. The marker locates the temple site; surviving halls are not all Tang buildings.

sites.title: 应天门遗址
sites.detail: 隋唐洛阳宫城正南门，始建于605年，是宫廷礼仪与庆典的重要场所。历史上曾用则天门、神龙门等名称；本图层以遗址通称标示，今展示建筑为现代保护工程。
sites.detailEn: The southern gate of Luoyang’s palace city was founded in 605 and hosted court ceremonies. It had several historical names; this marker uses the site’s familiar name. Today’s display building is modern.

sites.title: 定鼎门遗址
sites.detail: 隋唐洛阳外郭城南门，与宫城南门应天门分属不同城垣。遗址保存门址、里坊及水系等遗存，可见丝绸之路东端都城的城市结构。
sites.detailEn: The southern gate of Luoyang’s outer city stood separately from the palace gate. Excavated gate, neighborhood and water-system remains illuminate the Silk Road capital’s urban layout.
